title: The Google TV Streamer now costs $50 more
summary: Google has increased the price of its 4K Google TV Streamer from $99 to $149, a $50 hike that mirrors recent price increases across its product lineup and the broader tech industry. The price increase comes weeks after the Pixel 11 launch and amid component shortage-driven price hikes affecting streaming devices, laptops, and game consoles.
content:
Google raised the price of its 4K streaming box to $149, up $50 from its original $99 price. The new price is currently live at the Google Store and Best Buy, but Amazon appears to still be offering the original price. 
The price hike comes just a couple of weeks after Google launched its new lineup of Pixel 11 phones with a $100 price hike over their Pixel 10 counterparts. 
The Google TV Streamer originally launched in 2024 and doubles as a smart home hub. It isn't the only streaming device getting more expensive - component shortages have been driving up prices on everything from laptops to game consoles. Earlier this month, Amazon incre …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Google TV Streamer现在贵了50美元
zh.summary: 谷歌将其4K Google TV Streamer的价格从99美元提高到149美元，涨价50美元，这反映了其产品线和更广泛科技行业近期的价格上涨趋势。这次价格上涨发生在Pixel 11推出数周后，也正值零部件短缺导致的流媒体设备、笔记本电脑和游戏机价格上涨。

title: A group funded by Andreessen, Horowitz, and Brockman plans data center ads to sway midterms
summary: Build American AI, a group backed by venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz and OpenAI founder Sam Brockman, plans to spend millions on advertisements promoting data centers to voters in select states during the midterm elections. The lobbying effort aims to influence public opinion on data center infrastructure through targeted media campaigns.
content: Build American AI plans to lobby voters in select states about the virtues of data centers by spending millions of dollars on ads.

zh.title: 由Andreessen、Horowitz和Brockman资助的团体计划投放数据中心广告以影响中期选举
zh.summary: Build American AI是由风险投资家Andreessen Horowitz和OpenAI创始人Sam Brockman支持的团体，计划在中期选举期间投入数百万美元在特定州投放广告推广数据中心。这项游说活动旨在通过有针对性的媒体宣传活动影响公众对数据中心基础设施的看法。

title: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
summary: JMGO's Iris Ultra Max 4K 120Hz projector, now available outside China, features an innovative dual-iris system that delivers 6,500 ISO lumens brightness and a 10,000:1 native contrast ratio. The dual-aperture design improves light control compared to traditional single-iris systems, making it suitable for gaming and sports viewing.
content:
JMGO’s Iris Ultra Max 4K 120Hz Google TV projector. | Image: JMGO	

JMGO's 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max all-in-one Google TV projector is now available outside China. It gets its name from a new dual-iris system that lets it produce an impressive 10,000:1 native contrast, according to JMGO. It boosts the contrast - always an issue with projectors - by placing two separate physical apertures (irises) along different points of the internal optical path to control light scatter and brightness far more aggressively than a single iris can. It also promises to produce a very bright 6,500 ISO lumen image from its triple-laser light engine.
Last year at IFA, 6,000 lumens from an all-in-one projector was breaking new gro …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: JMGO超亮一体化投影仪非常适合游戏玩家和体育爱好者
zh.summary: JMGO的Iris Ultra Max 4K 120Hz投影仪现已在中国以外地区推出，采用创新的双光圈系统，提供6500 ISO流明的亮度和10000:1的原生对比度。双光圈设计相比传统单光圈系统改进了光线控制，使其适合游戏和体育观看。

title: FTC lawsuit alleges Amazon has been ‘secretly and systematically’ overcharging for ads
summary: The FTC and 22 state attorneys general are suing Amazon for allegedly using a "secret ad surcharge" to inflate advertising prices, with costs passed to consumers. The complaint alleges Amazon violated the FTC Act and state laws through its second-price auction mechanism, following a $2.5 billion FTC settlement just one year prior.
content:
The FTC and 22 state attorneys general are suing Amazon for allegedly using a "secret ad surcharge" to drive up prices for ads on its website and app. FTC chairman Andrew Ferguson claims in a blog post on the lawsuit that the higher advertising prices "were largely passed on to American consumers." According to the complaint, Amazon violated the FTC Act and over a dozen state laws. This lawsuit comes almost a year after Amazon agreed to pay $2.5 billion to settle an earlier FTC lawsuit over Prime subscription practices. 
In Amazon's "second price" auctions for ads on its platform, the winning bidder is supposed to only pay one cent more tha …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: FTC诉讼指控亚马逊"秘密系统性地"过度收费广告
zh.summary: 美国联邦贸易委员会(FTC)和22个州司法部长正在起诉亚马逊，指控其使用"秘密广告附加费"抬高广告价格，成本转嫁给消费者。该诉状声称亚马逊通过第二价格拍卖机制违反了《FTC法》和州法律，这发生在仅一年前FTC与亚马逊达成25亿美元和解之后。

title: I went to the loneliest baseball game on Apple Vision Pro
summary: A journalist experienced Apple's immersive virtual reality broadcast of a Boston Red Sox vs. New York Yankees game on Apple Vision Pro, finding it technically impressive but questioning its practical value. The experimental series marks Apple's first foray into streaming live sports through spatial computing, raising questions about the future of VR sports viewership.
content:
Ceddanne Rafaela is tagged out at home plate at Yankee Stadium on August 28th. | Getty Images	

This weekend, I strapped on an Apple Vision Pro to watch a baseball game in immersive virtual reality for the first time. It was technically impressive, visually pretty remarkable, and also didn't make that much sense.
Apple and Major League Baseball chose a classic match-up of the Boston Red Sox and the New York Yankees for the first of its series of four games streamed on the device. I do not review tech for The Verge, but I do watch a lot of baseball - if there's a game on and I'm at home, it's likely on my television. If this is the future of sports, live events, and wearable technology in general, I'd like to see what all the fuss is a …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 我在Apple Vision Pro上观看了最孤独的棒球比赛
zh.summary: 一位记者体验了Apple通过Vision Pro进行的波士顿红袜队对纽约洋基队比赛的沉浸式虚拟现实直播，认为技术上令人印象深刻，但质疑其实际价值。这个实验性系列标志着Apple首次通过空间计算进行直播体育，引发了人们对虚拟现实体育观看未来的疑问。

title: FTC accuses Amazon of running a ‘secret ad surcharge scheme’ in new lawsuit
summary: The FTC and 22 state attorneys general filed a lawsuit against Amazon for allegedly secretly charging businesses inflated advertising rates on its platform. The legal action claims Amazon violated federal trade law and multiple state consumer protection statutes through its ad pricing practices.
content: Amazon is facing a new lawsuit from the FTC and 22 states for allegedly secretly charging businesses more for advertising.

zh.title: FTC在新诉讼中指控亚马逊运营"秘密广告附加费计划"
zh.summary: 美国联邦贸易委员会(FTC)和22个州司法部长对亚马逊提起诉讼，指控其秘密向商家收取平台上虚高的广告费率。该诉讼声称亚马逊通过广告定价行为违反了联邦贸易法和多项州消费者保护法。

title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
summary: The Pentagon is integrating versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceX's Grok into its central AI tools portal alongside Google's Gemini. The move provides military and defense personnel access to multiple major AI systems through a unified platform for national security applications.
content: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

zh.title: 美国国防部推出自有ChatGPT和Grok版本
zh.summary: 五角大楼正在将OpenAI的ChatGPT和SpaceX的Grok集成到其中央AI工具门户中，与谷歌的Gemini一起提供。此举为军方和国防人员通过统一平台访问多个主要AI系统提供了便利，用于国家安全应用。

title: Review: Coyote vs. Acme is an unabashed love letter to Looney Tunes
summary: Director Dave Green's live-action and animated hybrid film celebrates the subversive humor and character-driven storytelling of classic Looney Tunes cartoons. The movie captures the smart, irreverent spirit that defined the original animated series in a nostalgic yet inventive tribute.
content: Director Dave Green's live action/animated hybrid captures smart, subversive weirdness of the classic cartoons.

zh.title: 影评：《郊狼大战ACME》是对《乐一通》的真挚致敬
zh.summary: 导演戴夫·格林的真人与动画混合影片赞颂了经典《乐一通》动画片的颠覆性幽默和角色驱动的叙事方式。这部电影以怀旧而富有创意的方式捕捉了原始动画系列的聪慧而不羁的精神。

title: Apply now to host a Side Event at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: TechCrunch is accepting applications for Side Event hosts at its 2026 Disrupt conference before the September 4 deadline. Side Events allow organizations to host their own programming and engage with the Disrupt community, providing visibility at one of tech's major annual conferences.
content: Apply before September 4 to be a part of the TechCrunch Disrupt community by hosting your own Side Event.

zh.title: 申请在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026大会上举办分论坛
zh.summary: TechCrunch正在接受其2026年Disrupt大会分论坛主办人的申请，申请截止日期为9月4日。分论坛允许组织举办自己的专题活动并与Disrupt社区互动，在科技行业最重要的年度会议之一获得曝光机会。

title: Alienware’s budget-friendly QD-OLED is discounted for the first time
summary: Dell is offering the Alienware AW2726DM gaming monitor at a $30 discount (down to $319.99), featuring a QD-OLED panel, 240Hz refresh rate, and AMD FreeSync Premium Plus support. The 27-inch monitor delivers high-contrast visuals and fast response times with a three-year warranty including burn-in coverage.
content:
The Alienware AW2726DM is a wallet-friendly screen with premium features for gaming.	

While memory and storage prices are still high, there are still good discounts on other gaming-related hardware. Take Alienware’s AW2726DM, for example. Dell is selling it for $319.99, a $30 break from the usual price of $349.99. The 27-inch gaming monitor features an QD-OLED panel for deep, immersive black levels, and quantum dots for full and vivid colors. With a 240Hz refresh rate for super smooth gaming, and AMD FreeSync Premium Plus to keep your frames per second and refresh rate locked together, this monitor is a great, budget-friendly choice for PC gamers who don’t want to compromise on contrast and fast response times.
Alienware AW2726DM QD-OLED monitor

Where to Buy:

 $349.99 $319.99 at Dell

Connectivity is a bit limited, with a DisplayPort 1.4 port that supports up to 240Hz at 2560 x 1440, and two HDMI ports that support up to 120Hz at its peak resolution. While some other screens have USB hubs or audio connections, they aren’t necessary for PC gaming, and sometimes add to the cost. The included stand has adjustable swivel, height, pivot, and tilt, with a 100 x 100 VESA mount in case you want to mount it to a monitor arm or use a different stand. It also sports a lengthy three year warranty with coverage for burn-in.
Read our Alienware AW2726DM hands-on.

zh.title: Alienware平价QD-OLED显示器首次打折
zh.summary: 戴尔推出Alienware AW2726DM游戏显示器，优惠30美元至319.99美元，配备QD-OLED面板、240Hz刷新率和AMD FreeSync Premium Plus支持。这款27英寸显示器提供高对比度画面和快速响应时间，并包含三年保修（含烧屏保障）。

title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
summary: Instagram is implementing new restrictions on AI profiles that are not clearly labeled as artificial intelligence, responding to growing user frustration with AI influencers. The limitations reduce the reach and visibility of undisclosed AI accounts on the platform.
content: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.

zh.title: Instagram限制未披露的AI账户
zh.summary: 应对用户对AI影响者的不满，Instagram对未明确标记为AI的账户实施新限制，降低了这些账户在平台上的影响力和可见度。

title: Apple’s top App Store exec, Phil Schiller, follows wave of exits as CEO Tim Cook steps down
summary: Phil Schiller, Apple's longtime App Store executive, is not immediately leaving the company but his role signals a shift as CEO Tim Cook reduces his responsibilities. The transition represents one of several departures among Apple's senior leadership, with staff indicating this may be a step toward Schiller's eventual retirement.
content: The longtime executive won't be leaving Apple just yet but staff at the company say it's a step closer to Schiller retiring.

zh.title: 苹果App Store高管菲尔·席勒在蒂姆·库克卸任时追随离职潮
zh.summary: 苹果App Store长期高管菲尔·席勒暂未立即离职，但其角色变化预示了首席执行官蒂姆·库克职责的调整。这是苹果高管层的多次离职之一，员工表示这可能是席勒最终退休的前兆。

title: Microsoft tests fix for latest hours-long Outlook outage
summary: Microsoft is testing a fix for a widespread Outlook outage that caused email delays and delivery failures affecting users globally. The outage represents the latest in a series of significant service disruptions for the email platform.
content: Microsoft says it's testing a fix for the widespread Outlook issues that have led to email delays and failures.

zh.title: 微软测试最新数小时Outlook宕机的修复方案
zh.summary: 微软正在测试针对大规模Outlook宕机的修复方案，该宕机导致电子邮件延迟和传递失败，影响了全球用户。此次宕机是该电子邮件平台一系列重大服务中断中的最新一次。

title: Kalshi bans George Santos for life over State of the Union bets
summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi has permanently banned former congressman George Santos over violations related to State of the Union betting activities. The disciplinary action comes two months after the CFTC settled charges against Santos.
content: The disciplinary action comes two months after the Commodity Futures Trading Commission settled charges against Santos.

zh.title: 卡尔希因国情咨文赌注永久禁止乔治·桑托斯
zh.summary: 预测市场平台卡尔希因与国情咨文博彩活动相关的违规行为而永久禁止前众议院议员乔治·桑托斯。此纪律处分发生在商品期货交易委员会与桑托斯达成诉讼和解两个月后。

title: Trump tells FCC to punish journalist for calling his election results "mixed"
summary: Former President Trump demanded the FCC punish NBC journalist Kristen Welker for describing his primary endorsement results as "mixed" rather than uniformly positive. The incident highlights ongoing tensions between Trump and mainstream media outlets over election coverage framing.
content: Trump furious at NBC's Kristen Welker for saying he had mixed results in primary endorsements.

zh.title: 特朗普要求联邦通信委员会因记者称选举结果"混合"而惩罚该记者
zh.summary: 前总统特朗普要求联邦通信委员会惩罚全国广播公司记者克里斯汀·韦尔克，理由是她将他的初选背书结果描述为"混合"而非一致积极。该事件突显了特朗普与主流媒体在选举报道框架上的持续紧张关系。

title: Pocket's AI made my game ideas real. Now Meta controls the results.
summary: Meta's Pocket AI tool enables creators to easily build interactive mobile games, but severely restricts how those creations can be shared outside Meta's ecosystem. This vendor lock-in illustrates the growing tension between platform accessibility for creators and their independence to distribute work freely. The disparity raises concerns about developer autonomy in an era of AI-assisted content creation.
content: Interactive mobile "gizmos" are easy to make, hard to share outside Meta's platform.

zh.title: Pocket的AI将我的游戏想法变成现实。现在Meta掌控了成果。
zh.summary: Meta的Pocket AI工具让创作者能够轻松构建交互式手机游戏，但严格限制了这些创作在Meta生态系统之外的分享方式。这种供应商锁定现象反映了平台可访问性与创作者作品自由分发权之间不断加剧的矛盾。这引发了人们对AI辅助内容创作时代开发者自主权的深切担忧。

title: The U.S. is building barriers around drones and robots, but China has scale to get around them
summary: The U.S. is implementing restrictions on foreign-made drones and robots to limit Chinese technology influence in critical sectors. However, China's manufacturing scale suggests these barriers may redirect competition to other markets rather than eliminate it. The policy reflects escalating U.S.-China tech competition and protectionist trends.
content: The U.S. is shutting out more foreign-made drones and robots. China’s scale means the global competition may simply move elsewhere.

zh.title: 美国正在为无人机和机器人设置障碍，但中国的规模让它有办法绕过
zh.summary: 美国正在对外国制造的无人机和机器人实施限制，以限制中国技术对关键部门的影响。然而，中国的制造规模表明这些障碍可能只会将竞争转向其他市场，而不是消除竞争。这项政策反映了美中科技竞争和保护主义趋势的升级。

title: Grindr wants to be the everything app for gay men; investors are still deciding whether it can pull it off
summary: Grindr CEO George Arison is expanding the dating app into a comprehensive platform with AI features, a premium tier, and healthcare services to counter Wall Street's historical undervaluation. The company aims to position itself as an all-encompassing social platform for gay men. Investor confidence in the expansion strategy remains uncertain.
content: George Arison is done letting Wall Street's "Grindr discount" go unchallenged — in a wide-ranging Q&A, the CEO walks us through how AI, a controversial $350-plus EDGE tier, and a bet on healthcare and long-distance matchmaking are turning Grindr into the "gayborhood in your pocket" he's been promising since 2022.

zh.title: Grindr想成为同志男性的全能应用；投资者仍在决定它是否能做到
zh.summary: Grindr首席执行官乔治·艾瑞松正在将这款约会应用扩展为一个全面平台，包括人工智能功能、高级订阅和医疗保健服务，以对抗华尔街长期以来对其的低估。该公司旨在将自己定位为同志男性的全方位社交平台。投资者对这一扩展战略的信心仍然不确定。
